summary: Multi-stage network-socket initialisation chain with error propagation. If the socket-array state is already initialised (first DWORD non-zero) it returns 4 immediately. Otherwise it creates the socket array, creates a UDP broadcast socket, and runs a follow-up setup stage; each stage returns early on failure. On full success it clears two state DWORDs at a1[28] and a1[29], and unless a2 is non-zero, enters PollingLoopWithProcessCalls.

operations.description: Guard: if *a1 is non-zero (socket-array state already initialised), return 4 immediately.
Call SocketArrayCreate(a1) and store the result as the chain status.
Guard: if the SocketArrayCreate result is non-zero, propagate that result as the return value.
Call CreateUdpBroadcastSocket(a1) and store the result as the chain status.
Guard: if the CreateUdpBroadcastSocket result is non-zero, propagate that result as the return value.
Call sub_5630D0(a1, a3, a4, a5) to run the follow-up setup stage and store its result.
Guard: if the sub_5630D0 result is non-zero, propagate that result as the return value.
Clear initialisation/state markers: a1[28] = 0 and a1[29] = 0 on the success path.
Guard: if a2 is zero, call PollingLoopWithProcessCalls(a1); a non-zero a2 skips the polling loop.
Return 0 on the fully-successful path; otherwise return the stored non-zero stage result.

unresolved: Meaning of the early-return literal 4 and of a1[28]/a1[29] (state markers) is not resolved.
Purpose of a2 (skips the polling loop when non-zero) is not established from this packet alone.
sub_5630D0, SocketArrayCreate, CreateUdpBroadcastSocket and PollingLoopWithProcessCalls bodies are out of scope here.
